name: dsh-virtual-avatar
description: Unified virtual persona and companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.check: node --check src/index.mjs && find src/migration src/persona src/characters/deepseek-whale src/memory src/storage src/ppl src/host -type f \( -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.js' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check src/client/index.mjs && node --check src/client/companion.mjs && node --check lib/client.js
scripts.verify: npm run build:client && npm run check && npm test && npm run pack:check
